fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Isolate the suspicious gNB/eNodeB via OSS using IMSI-based blacklisting rules.
Enforce NAS security mode command (NSC) validation for all UEs.
Deploy NAS message replay attack detection with sequence number counters.
Set NAS timer T3450 (UE inactivity) to 30 seconds for anomaly detection.
Enable NAS integrity protection for all NAS messages with KSI counters.
Configure RAN to drop NAS messages from unknown MME/S-GW IPs.
Implement NAS state machine validation with state transition KPIs.
Deploy NAS message rate limiting (e.g., 5 messages/minute per UE).
Monitor NAS-EPS EMM state transitions for unexpected values like 125.
Trigger automated RAN reconfiguration for gNBs with repeated NAS anomalies.
